Studio editor can surface diagnostics. Shares the fields of the matching registration body.

searchTerm.description:
The substring to look for across every property value (case-insensitive). Required
and non-blank.

label.description: Optional restrictor: only elements with exactly this label match.

resultType.description:
Specifies which types of graph elements to include in the results. Defaults to
ResultTypeSpecification.Both (discovery wants everything); the explicit
initializer is load-bearing because the enum's zero value is
ResultTypeSpecification.Vertices, so an omitted field would otherwise
deserialize to Vertices.

PropertySearchSpecification.description:
Specification for a cold, un-indexed discovery scan across EVERY property of every
element: an element matches when any of its property values, rendered to text, contains
the search term (case-insensitive). Unlike ScanSpecification there is no
operator or typed literal - just a substring term.

propertyId.description: The identifier name of the property

fullQualifiedTypeName.description: The fully qualified .NET type name of the property

propertyValue.description: The string representation of the property value

PropertySpecification.description: Defines a property with name, type, and value for plugin configuration

graphElementId.description:
The element to write to. An in-range but absent id is a committed no-op (matching the
single-element routes); an out-of-range id rolls the WHOLE batch back.

remove.description:
When `true` the property is REMOVED and the value fields are ignored. Removing an
absent property succeeds and changes nothing, which makes a replayed batch safe.

propertyId.description: The identifier name of the property

fullQualifiedTypeName.description: The fully qualified .NET type name of the property

propertyValue.description: The string representation of the property value

PropertyWriteSpecification.description:
One write in a `PUT /graphelements/properties` batch (feature
platform-integrity-audit W2): set string PropertySpecification.PropertyId on
int PropertyWriteSpecification.GraphElementId to the given value, or REMOVE it when bool PropertyWriteSpecification.Remove
is `true`.

Writes have REPLACE semantics, so a key that already exists is overwritten. Setting a
key to the value it already holds, or removing one that is already absent, is a TRUE no-op:
it bumps no modification date and publishes no change-feed event. That is what lets a caller
re-assert the state an external source describes without producing mutations.

indexId.description: The identifier of the index to scan

leftLimit.description: The lower bound of the range as a string representation

rightLimit.description: The upper bound of the range as a string representation

fullQualifiedTypeName.description: The fully qualified .NET type name of the range values

resultType.description: Specifies which types of graph elements to include in the results

RangeIndexScanSpecification.description: Specification for performing a range-based scan on an index

ResultTypeSpecification.description: Specifies which types of graph elements to include in query results

usedMemoryBytes.description: The process's working set (physical RAM in use) when the save was taken, in bytes.

SaveGameKpisREST.description: Cheap KPIs captured at save/import time - values the engine already has, no graph scan.

name.description: The namespace name at save time (restores under this name).

id.description:
The namespace's IMMUTABLE id at save time — what the boot chain matches on, so a
rename never orphans a namespace's newest save and a drop+recreate (fresh id) never
resurrects the dropped one's checkpoints. Null on pre-namespace (v1) entries, which
normalize to the default namespace's stable id.

location.description: Absolute path of this namespace's primary checkpoint file.

fileCount.description: Number of files belonging to this namespace's checkpoint.

totalBytes.description: Total size of those files in bytes at registration time.

SaveGameNamespaceREST.description:
One namespace inside a save game: its own checkpoint location, file facts, and KPIs
(feature graph-namespaces, registry schema v2).

id.description: Stable id; sortable timestamp prefix + random suffix. The REST identifier.

savedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the save game was created (or the file's write time for imports).

trigger.description: How the entry was created: "api", "shutdown" or "imported".

location.description: Absolute path of the primary checkpoint file.

fileCount.description: Number of files belonging to this save game (checkpoint + partitions + sidecars).

totalBytes.description: Total size of those files in bytes at registration time.

engineVersion.description: The engine/assembly version that produced the entry.

namespaces.description:
The namespaces this save game contains (feature graph-namespaces, registry schema v2).
Null on pre-namespace (v1) entries, which are read forever as "a default-only save"
whose checkpoint is string SaveGameREST.Location. On single-namespace entries the top-level
location/kpis mirror the one member (v1-shaped); on multi-namespace entries the
top-level location is null and fileCount/totalBytes are sums across the members.

skippedNamespaces.description:
The namespaces `PUT /save/all` did NOT save because they are cataloged but not
loaded in this process (feature namespace-startup-load): the entry therefore spans a
strict SUBSET of the Fallen-8, and a caller reading only `namespaces` could not tell
that from a Fallen-8 that has no other namespaces.
Transient, and the ONLY field on this DTO that is: it describes one operation
rather than the registered save game, so it is set on that response alone and is null
(hence omitted, and absent from savegames.json) everywhere else. A header was
rejected because namespace names may contain commas and non-ASCII characters, neither of
which a header value can carry faithfully.

activatedNamespaces.description:
The namespaces `PUT /savegames/{id}/load` had to LOAD into this process before it
could restore into them, because they were cataloged but not loaded (feature
namespace-startup-load, spec decision 8.3). Their startup-load policy was set to
`enabled` in the same request - restoring data into a namespace the next boot skips
would make it invisible again, which is the trap 8.3 exists to close - so this one member
reports both halves of a single decision.
Transient in exactly the way List<string> SaveGameREST.SkippedNamespaces is (see there for the
reasoning, which is the same and lives in one place): it describes one operation, not the
registered save game, so it is null - hence omitted, and absent from
savegames.json - everywhere else.

The binary operator to use for comparing property values, sent as its integer code:
0 Equals, 1 Greater, 2 GreaterOrEquals, 3 Lower, 4 LowerOrEquals, 5 NotEquals.
A member name is not accepted: unlike resultType, this enum carries no string-enum
converter, so the code is the wire form (this summary is the mapping's one home,
since the generated schema shows only "integer").

literal.description: The literal value to compare against

label.description: Optional restrictor: only elements with exactly this label match

resultType.description: Specifies which types of graph elements to include in the results

ScoredVertexREST.description:
One scored vertex (score algorithms), rows ordered score-descending with
    ascending-id tie-break.

indexId.description: The identifier of the spatial index to search

graphElementId.description: The identifier of the reference graph element for the distance calculation

distance.description: The maximum distance to search within

SearchDistanceSpecification.description: Specification for performing spatial distance searches in the graph

embedding.description: The embedding provider state (may be null when no provider is wired).

chat.description: The chat gateway state (may be null when no provider is wired).

SemanticConfigREST.description: The semantic providers (embedding + chat) grouped as one view.

queryVector.description: The query vector to score elements against.

queryText.description:
A query TEXT to embed instead of supplying float[] SemanticTraversalSpecification.QueryVector (feature
embedding-provider; mutually exclusive with it). Embedded ONCE, before the
traversal starts, by the active provider - requires the EmbeddingProvider
capability (403 when `Fallen8:Embedding:Enabled` is off).

metric.description: The metric: Cosine (default), DotProduct or L2.

minScore.description:
Optional declarative filter threshold: an element passes when its named embedding
scores at least this well (at most, under L2); elements without the embedding are
filtered.

costBySimilarity.description:
Optional declarative vertex cost (path requests only): Cosine maps to
`1 - score`, L2 to the distance itself; DotProduct has no honest non-negative
mapping and is rejected. Vertices without the embedding are filtered.

SemanticTraversalSpecification.description:
The declarative semantic block of a path or subgraph request (feature
element-embeddings). Carries the query vector for the traversal context - embedded
ONCE, before the traversal starts - plus optional code-free filter/cost derivations.
Pure data (it compiles no C#); conflicts with a C# fragment or a
stored query owning the same delegate slot are rejected (one owner per slot).

usedMemory.description:
The database process's working set (physical RAM currently in use), in bytes — the
figure an operator reads as "memory used" (matches /statistics processWorkingSetBytes).
NOT the reserved virtual address space, which modern .NET makes enormous.

namespaceState.description:
The addressed namespace's residency (feature namespace-startup-load): `ready`
normally, `notLoaded` when this namespace is cataloged but has no engine in this
process. In that state every engine-derived field on this response is ABSENT (null)
rather than zero or empty - a zero count reads as "healthy and empty" both to the
first-run walkthrough and to a client that deletes state because nothing asserts it any
more. Only this probe answers for a not-loaded namespace; every other namespace-scoped
route refuses with 503.

vertexCount.description:
The total number of vertices in the addressed namespace, or null when it is
`notLoaded` (see string StatusREST.NamespaceState)

edgeCount.description:
The total number of edges in the addressed namespace, or null when it is
`notLoaded` (see string StatusREST.NamespaceState)

indices.description:
The indices currently registered on this instance (id + plugin type) — the live
inventory, available without running the budgeted statistics pass

availableIndexPlugins.description: List of available index plugins that can be used with the database

availablePathPlugins.description: List of available path-finding algorithm plugins

availableSubGraphPlugins.description:
List of available subgraph algorithm plugins (reflection-discovered built-ins unioned
with the addressed namespace's runtime-registered subgraph plugins)

availableAnalyticsPlugins.description: List of available graph-analytics algorithm plugins

availableServicePlugins.description: List of available service plugins that can be started with the database

apiKeyRequired.description:
True when this server has an API key configured, i.e. every endpoint outside the
anonymous allowlist answers 401 without a valid credential. /status itself stays
anonymous, so it doubles as the connection probe: a caller is authorized iff
`!ApiKeyRequired || Authenticated`.

authenticated.description:
True when the request that produced this status carried a valid credential
(see bool StatusREST.ApiKeyRequired for how clients combine the two).

embedding.description:
The embedding provider state (feature embedding-provider) — here on the cheap
discovery surface because it is a config read, not a graph pass; null only when
the host wired no provider. See EmbeddingProviderStatsREST.

chat.description:
The chat gateway state (feature instance-config) — a config read like
EmbeddingProviderStatsREST StatusREST.Embedding, so it rides the cheap probe for capability discovery
(e.g. the MCP overview's chatEnabled). Null when the host wired no provider. The
GPU field stays null here; GET /config carries the probed value.

ingestion.description:
The unstructured-ingestion state (feature unstructured-ingestion): a config read
plus a cached sidecar probe, so it rides the cheap discovery surface too. Null
only when the host wired no ingestion options.

nlp.description:
The semantic-layer NLP enrichment state (feature semantic-layer): a config read
plus a cached sidecar probe. Null only when the host wired no NLP options.

durability.description:
Whether this namespace's writes are actually reaching disk, and whether the state being
served is the complete committed history or a prefix of it (feature
platform-integrity-audit W5). A cheap read of state the engine already publishes.

StatusREST.description: Represents the current status of the Fallen-8 database

filter.description: Filtering criteria for elements to include in path calculations.

cost.description: Cost function specifications for weighting paths.

The stored form of a path query: the `filter`/`cost` blocks of a

`maxPathWeight`) and the algorithm name stay per-request.

The stored specification document (JSON text): the registration request's
`path` / `subGraph` block exactly as stored.

The compiler diagnostics of a failed rehydration recompile; null unless
string StoredQuerySummaryREST.CompileState is `Failed`.

The compile state: `Compiled` (invocable), `Failed` (a rehydration
recompile failed - see the detail response's diagnostics; invoking returns 409), or
`SourceOnly` (loaded without a compiler).

Full detail of a registered stored query, INCLUDING its source specification - the
library is transparent to its operator (and `GET` covers manual migration between
instances).

name.description:
The unique name to register the query under. Restricted to
`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$` (always a safe URL path segment); compared
case-sensitively.

The stored query kind: `Path` (a filter/cost set for `POST /path`) or
`SubGraph` (a pattern template for `PUT /subgraph`).

The subgraph pattern template block (required iff string StoredQuerySpecification.Kind is
`SubGraph`). The subgraph instance name and additional information stay
per-request on `PUT /subgraph` and are not part of the stored template.

Specification for registering a stored query (feature stored-query-library): a named,
validated, pre-compiled query definition that the path/subgraph endpoints can afterwards
reference by name - invocation compiles nothing (the pinned artifact runs).

compileState.description:
The compile state: `Compiled` (invocable), `Failed` (a rehydration
recompile failed - see the detail response's diagnostics; invoking returns 409), or
`SourceOnly` (loaded without a compiler).

vertexFilter.description:
Optional pre-filter selecting which vertices are copied into the subgraph
(a C# fragment receiving a `VertexModel`).

edgeFilter.description:
Optional pre-filter selecting which edges are copied into the subgraph
(a C# fragment receiving an `EdgeModel`; filter by type via
`e.EdgePropertyId`).

patterns.description:
Ordered pattern sequence describing the paths to keep (see
List<PatternSpecification> SubGraphSpecification.Patterns).

StoredSubGraphQueryBlock.description:
The stored form of a subgraph query: a SubGraphSpecification WITHOUT the
per-instance `name`/`additionalInformation` fields.

SubGraphPatternThresholdSummary.description: One vertex pattern step's semantic threshold, identified by name or position.

embeddingName.description: The named embedding the subgraph's filters score (effective, so never null).

metric.description: The metric the scores are computed under (effective, so never null).

dimension.description: The dimension of the bound query vector.

queryText.description:
The query text the vector was resolved from at registration, when the subgraph was
created via `semantic.queryText`; null for client-supplied vectors. Documents
intent - the bound vector remains the truth and is never re-embedded.

minScore.description: The top-level vertex pre-filter threshold (`semantic.minScore`), when set.

patternThresholds.description: The vertex pattern steps carrying a `semanticMinScore`, when any.

SubGraphSemanticSummary.description:
The bound semantic state of a registered subgraph (feature
subgraph-semantic-thresholds), echoed on its summary: the query the subgraph's
filters were registered against and where its thresholds sit. The raw query vector is
deliberately NOT part of the echo - only its dimension; a registered subgraph reveals
its binding, not its payload.

name.description: Unique name the subgraph is registered under.

additionalInformation.description: Optional metadata attached to the subgraph definition.

vertexFilter.description:
Optional pre-filter selecting which vertices are copied into the subgraph.
Null or empty copies all vertices. The lambda receives a `VertexModel`.

edgeFilter.description:
Optional pre-filter selecting which edges are copied into the subgraph. Null
or empty copies all edges whose endpoints were copied. The lambda receives an
`EdgeModel`; filter by type via `e.EdgePropertyId`.

patterns.description:
Ordered pattern sequence describing the paths to keep. Should alternate
vertex ↔ edge and start with a vertex pattern. Empty means "no pruning".

algorithm.description:
Optional name of the subgraph algorithm plugin that performs the extraction, as
reported by the plugin's `PluginName`. Accepts a built-in name or the name a
plugin of contract `SubGraph` was registered under in this namespace (the set
`GET /status` reports as `availableSubGraphPlugins`); an unknown name is a
400, never a silent fallback. Omitted (null or empty) selects the built-in
breadth-first search algorithm, which is what every request without this field gets.
The selected name is stored with the subgraph, so a recalculation re-resolves the same
plugin.

The name of a registered stored query of kind `SubGraph` to instantiate instead
of inline string SubGraphSpecification.VertexFilter/string SubGraphSpecification.EdgeFilter/List<PatternSpecification> SubGraphSpecification.Patterns
fragments (feature stored-query-library). Mutually exclusive with them (400 when
mixed); string SubGraphSpecification.Name (and optional Dictionary<string, string> SubGraphSpecification.AdditionalInformation) stay
required per instance. A stored-query request compiles nothing (the pinned template
is instantiated).

The declarative semantic block (feature element-embeddings): the query vector the
compiled filters' traversal context carries, plus an optional code-free
`minScore` vertex pre-filter. Bound at REGISTRATION time - recalculation
reuses the same delegates and never embeds anything. Pure data (it compiles no C#);
mutually exclusive with string SubGraphSpecification.StoredQuery and, when
`minScore` is set, with an inline string SubGraphSpecification.VertexFilter fragment.

semantic.description:
